findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_catalog" references sensitive artifacts (keychain). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Ready-made parts customers can customize without a file: personalized name ornament, desk name plate, name keychain, place card holder, cable clips, headphone h…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_catalog · Private data: get_service_info, quote_file, list_catalog · Public sink: quote_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_catalog · Private data: get_service_info, quote_file, list_catalog · Public sink: quote_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
